result.summary: Several layout clipping issues: category chips, a restaurant card title, and the bottom popular card are cut off. Filter chips also lack enough trailing space.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped on the right, cutting off the restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels fully reveal card titles or add consistent right padding/peek so names are not truncated mid-word.

issues.description: The bottom popular restaurant card is cut off by the tab bar, so only the top of the image and promo badge are visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding above the tab bar so the last card is fully visible or clearly scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and a leftover circle), making it unclear there are more filters.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding and a visible peek of the next chip so the horizontal scroll is obvious.
